en.dr-ali-peiravi: 5-35 He (MGB) also said, “Anyone who doesn’t have one of the following will always have an incomplete life; be unwise and always worried:
health, security; abundance of daily bread; a sympathetic companion.”
He (MGB) was asked, “Who would constitute a sympathetic companion?” He (MGB) replied, “A good wife; a good child or a good friend.
And the last thing which includes all the others is comfort.”
